decisions.reason: The 2019 award signals a positive resolution of uncertainty, so the option is likely valuable and worth keeping.
Without differentiated results and with no later web presence, the single-U probe shows little sign of value, making abandonment likely.
Surface technology has no demonstrated traction and overlaps with the geothermal option set, so dropping it frees resources.
Fire-protection profiles fit the firm's core steel expertise and have low keeping costs, so the option remains open.
Slim profiles likely serve an adjacent core market with low incremental cost, so maintaining the option is warranted.
Decorative surfaces are less essential but still core-related; uncertainty remains, so keeping the option at moderate cost is reasonable.
